up: Retrieve exact IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human target PDE4B (CHEMBL275). For each result, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, the PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID if available), the assay description, and target details (target name and ChEMBL ID). Filter for exact IC50 values only (standard_relation = '=').
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL275'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
